toxicities: 与酒精或阿片等抑制剂混用可能致命。
summary: 一种中等作用时长的苯二氮卓，常称 Ativan，常作为 Xanax 的替代处方。具镇静、催眠和抗焦虑作用。过量可能导致失忆和抑制降低。不要与其他抑制剂合用。
effectsSummary: Lorazepam has anxiolytic, sedative and anticonvulsant effects. It is also used for acute anxiety and panic attacks.
generalRisks: Drowsiness, dizziness, weakness, unsteadiness. Risk of dependence. Dangerous with other depressants.
longtermRisks: Regular use leads to dependence. Withdrawal can be severe.
saferUse: 如果在线购买，实际成分可能与标识不同。
